Overall I really like this sunscreen - it has a light yet hydrating feel upon application, soaks well into the skin, and doesn't negatively affect my additional skincare or make-up routine. There is no strong scent or white cast to contend with either. It doesn't run to cause eye irritation which I've often had difficulty with in other face sunscreens. And as someone with sensitive skin, it doesn't appear to increase breakouts for me. As others have mentioned, it leans a bit watery in consistency which is likely what allows it to feel so light and not pill, but I do use 2 pumps to ensure full coverage. Thus far I haven't had any apparent sunburn issues with daily use/typical sun exposure, although I'd ensure reapplication if you intend to sunbathe. My only sadness is that it leans on the more expensive side, although I've gotten over 4 months of regular use from one of the 1.7oz containers thus far.

avis.titre: Watery Sunscreen That Doesn't Leave a White Cast
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this SPF. It's a mineral (physical) sunscreen, so it's important to keep in mind that you need to reapply it every 2 hours when you're outside to maintain proper protection. The texture is very lightweight and runny, almost like a liquid, which makes it effortless to apply and blend. It has a gentle, typical mineral sunscreen scent that isn't overpowering. On the skin, it feels very comfortable—never thick or heavy. I have combination skin, and this sunscreen worked really well for me. It sinks in quickly, doesn't leave any oily or sticky residue, and feels almost unnoticeable on the face. Many sunscreens can feel dense or create a layer on the skin, but this one feels very breathable because of its fluid consistency. The finish looks natural, with a slight hydrating effect, and it even feels a bit calming when applied. Another big advantage is that it doesn't leave a white cast, which is great for a mineral formula. The packaging is also well-designed—the pump dispenser is easy to use and makes application more convenient. I usually need about three pumps to cover my face. The only downside is that due to the thin texture, you might go through the product faster, and reapplying every 2 hours can be a bit inconvenient. However, the lightweight feel and comfort on the skin definitely make up for it. gifted by tatcha complimentary from tatcha
